Per-cell accessible name in the profile editor step matrix. {label} is the already-translated row label (Temperature, Pump,...) and {n} is the 1-based step number.

Accessible reading for a #43 locked value box whose visible content is a bare number: {label} is the already-translated caption beside it, {value} the already-formatted reading with its unit (e.g. "Lever P0", "8 bar"). #43's `label` takes the WHOLE accessible name because it makes the visible glyphs aria-hidden, so a caption alone announces no value at all.
{name} is the already-translated shot slot name ("Shot A"), so a translator sees the whole table name. Used when the slot holds no shot.

History data page: the phase table’s accessible name when the slot HOLDS a shot. {name} is the already-translated slot name ("Shot A"); {shot} is the shot’s own label, the same string painted in the caption beside the A/B disc and offered by the band’s pickers (shotOptionLabel).
